ruleName: Divots, tractor ruts, bald patches, etc.
group: Divots, tractor ruts, bald patches, etc.
title: Playing from a divot, rut or bald patch
question: Your ball lands in a deep divot or a tractor rut on the fairway. Which of these is correct?

choices.text: You must play the ball as it lies or take an unplayable lie and add a penalty
You can move the ball to some good grass without penalty
You are allowed to rehit your shot with no penalty

explanation: You have to play the ball as it lies, or declare it unplayable and take a penalty stroke—there is no free relief just for a divot or rut.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl in a navy top and red bottoms, addressing a golf ball lying in a deep divot on a fairway under an overcast sky, holding an iron club and ready to play.

issues: Golfer is not left-handed as specified in the sceneSpec and repair instructions—stance and club address appear right-handed.

Skin tone is slightly darker than specified 'medium' for a white teen.
Otherwise, the golf club, ball, course, and general posture are suitable and believable for golf.
